status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY COMPARATIVE FIT. DEV development on previously inspected simulations; not confirmation. Stage A and C4 are not executed under this request.

source_package.location: outputs/astra_week20_method_development (verbatim copy of the owner-supplied package)
source_package.role: reference code = initial numerical specification; design text = hypotheses

data_contract.label: canonical Y = any observed manually labelled Keyhole frame (pilot_inputs.has_keyhole)
data_contract.response: existing ACTIVE A (A_um, Week 19 audit; startup included; 90 %-of-derived-exit cutoff); z = log(A_um / 111) for valid positive A; missing A keeps its label and query cost
data_contract.exclusions: the 49 Bug-withheld NEW entries are outside NEW-136 and stay excluded; no label, exclusion or q20 change
data_contract.identifiers: full simulation IDs everywhere (H suffixes are not unique)

splits.NEW: src.week18_tasks R3_NEW = week12 original_splits.json (identical to the Week 19 pilot)
splits.POOLED: src.week18_tasks R1_POOLED (campaign x label stratified, default_rng([1818, rep]))

paths.routine: src.week13_synthetic_al.maximin_order on the raw inputs of the fold's training pool (StandardScaler inside), rng = task seed + [2]
paths.no_extension: prefixes are never extended to obtain a class composition; one-class prefixes are kept

transformations.J_family: log of the four raw inputs, standardized with the mean/sd of the fold's feature-only training pool (ddof 0); the discrepancy is centred on that fixed standardized pool
transformations.ACTIVE_E1: frozen: StandardScaler on log(pool X); log A standardized on paid finite responses

baseline_declared_behaviour.ACTIVE_E1: single-class usable pairs -> unavailable; logistic slope <= 0 -> failed_nonpositive_slope; non-positive response -> failed; otherwise predictions
baseline_declared_behaviour.G3: single-class paid labels -> unavailable; Laplace fixed-point error > 1e-6 or fallback -> failed_convergence; otherwise predictions

numerical_limits.E1: sklearn GPR L-BFGS-B, 0 restarts; logistic C=1e6, max_iter 5000
numerical_limits.G3: frozen safeguarded Laplace (FP_TOL 1e-9), one L-BFGS-B start
numerical_limits.threads: J fits: 2 BLAS threads; E1/G3: threadpool limit 2; at most 4 threads in total

evaluation.pooling: per repeat over the five test folds (every simulation once); headline = mean of the two repeats
metrics: q20 accuracy: unchanged membership, mean over folds with q20 points

short_K.definition: NEW positives with 0 < K/(F+C+K) < 0.10 (frac_K_FCK; not K/(K+C))

evaluation.contrasts: paired on identical tasks, restricted to the common available cohort; per-repeat values reported
evaluation.uncertainty: simulation-cluster bootstrap (2000 draws, seed 20261013): class-stratified multiplicities per simulation shared across repeats, budgets and arms; conditional on the stored fits

hypotheses.SM-H1_primary: NEW, B40, BA (pooled per repeat, mean of repeats 1-2): J > Binary_matched. Direction from the evidence that ACTIVE A carries canonical-label information on NEW (Week 20 C3: ACTIVE - WHOLE +0.044 [+0.023, +0.067]; ACTIVE ranks NEW labels better than G3: AUC +0.095). Magnitude unknown: the fixed positive depth coupling and fixed priors can also hurt (Astra adverse case).
hypotheses.SM-H2_specificity: NEW B40 specificity, J vs Binary_matched: no directional expectation (fast-scan negatives share depths with fast-scan positives; whether the centered discrepancy represents them under the fixed prior is unknown).
hypotheses.SM-H3_log_loss: NEW B40 log loss: J <= Binary_matched (direction from the better ACTIVE Brier scores on DEV and C3). Magnitude unknown.
hypotheses.SM-H4_OLD: OLD, B16 and B40 BA: J > Binary_matched. Direction: OLD labels are almost a threshold on A (Week 19 audit: A separates OLD labels with AUC about 0.9999), and the threshold prior is centred at 111 um, near the OLD reference threshold. Magnitude unknown.
hypotheses.SM-H5_POOLED: POOLED, J vs Binary_matched: no directional expectation (one global threshold plus a smooth discrepancy must absorb the OLD/NEW shift).
hypotheses.SM-H6_ablations: NEW B40 BA: J >= J_no_delta (the discrepancy is needed to represent fast-scan exceptions). J vs J_fixed_theta: no directional expectation. Magnitudes unknown.
hypotheses.SM-H7_systems: J vs G3 and J vs ACTIVE_E1: complete-system comparisons with different hyperparameter treatments; no directional expectation.
hypotheses.SM-H8_theta: Posterior theta SD at B40 is below the prior SD 0.35 in every population (labels inform theta). The theta-conditioning diagnostic changes probabilities by a magnitude that is unknown.
hypotheses.SM-H9_numerics: Every J-family fit is accepted by the gradient criterion (2e-6) and all leakage controls pass.
hypotheses.thresholds: +0.01 BA = practical improvement threshold; -0.01 BA = practical deterioration threshold. These are decision thresholds, not forecasts or equivalence margins.
hypotheses.null_result_reading: a failed screen means that an incremental benefit was not demonstrated for this model, prior and budget; it does not mean depth contains no label information.

decision_rule: Recommend Stage A iff numerical/leakage checks pass AND, on NEW at B40 (mean over repeats 1-2), J - Binary_matched BA >= +0.01, specificity(J) >= specificity(Binary_matched) and log loss(J) <= log loss(Binary_matched). q20, short-K and OLD/POOLED regressions are reported explicitly. A pragmatic development screen, not confirmation.
mechanism_diagnostics_predeclared: FP/FN by full ID per arm; strata: NEW negatives, fast scans (VX > 0.85), short-K, incomplete support (A missing or recording ends early)
theta posterior per fit; delta, response, latent margin, uncertainty and cross-covariances at test points
Astra theta-conditioning diagnostic vs J_fixed_theta refit
oracle-response diagnostic (held-out A, NOT deployable) for J and ACTIVE_E1 on the same simulations
ranking (AUC) vs probability scores (log loss, Brier) vs decisions (BA); reliability bins with counts
Laplace approximation error by elliptical slice sampling for J at NEW repeat 1, folds 1-5, B40
